alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A staircase room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a navy one on the right. The navy one looks away to the right and says hi to someone out of view. The black one says hi back with a big sway, until the navy one turns to it with a question mark and narrowed eyes. The black one goes wide-eyed and looks away. It happens again, and again the black one answers and gets caught. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me waving back at someone who wasn't waving at me.
